name: Boku no Koe ga Todoku Nara...
source:
Main character goes to another town to start life anew. But old memories don't let him go easily. He witnesses light in the classroom at midnight. Inside school idol girl is insulted by a masked stranger. Who is behind that mask? The wall of darkness engulfs him. Can he defeat that inner darkness and save the girl?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角前往另一座城市重新开始生活，可昔日的记忆不肯轻易放过他。午夜时分，他发现教室里亮着灯。校内的偶像少女正在里面遭一名蒙面人侮辱。面具后藏着谁？黑暗筑成的高墙将他吞没。他能否战胜内心的黑暗，救出少女？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
